title: A single disbursement dated ON OR AFTER the last repayment due date. The reference oracle silently DISCARDS it into an all-zero schedule with no disbursement row (ProgressiveLoanScheduleGenerator.java:305-308, the after-maturity arm gated on isMultiDisburseLoan() == false on this seam). Rather than reproduce that degenerate answer, the contract puts the shape outside the graded domain and requires ErrNoDiscriminatingVector. This is the vector that stops a port from 'helpfully' returning zeros: a port that reproduced the oracle's degenerate schedule here would look right and would be wrong, and no money-bearing vector could tell.

provenance.note: Derived from the ratified contract's own normative text. No oracle output is compared and no monetary value appears in this file.
